Hiring guidance

What to look for.

01

Documentation depth

Ask for sheet sets they produced, not only renders: plans, sections, details and schedules from the model.

02

Coordination habits

Good architectural modelers coordinate openings, cores and ceilings with structure and MEP before issue.

03

Families and templates

Check they can build and maintain families and view templates to your standards.
